reviews.classification: full actual source-report review; contextual evidence and proposed scale joins retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full181-line research report reviewed, including R1–R7, MI01–MI12/WS01–WS08/MA01–MA14/IR01–IR08/J1–J3, numeric example and implementation/acceptance limits. Source pages were inspected by the historical report, not reopened now. Official policy/doc, version-labelled wiki and dated design diary retain different evidence types. Reference-game play, installed source and current balance are explicitly unproved. NIST fitness-for-purpose and NASA readiness are analogies for evidence context, not compulsory player levels, external certification or current medical/scientific advice.

F2: Preserve composition/structure/fit, actual reading uncertainty, specific practice, part role, workmanship, unfinished work and repair/custody as selected-consumer dimensions. Strong appraisal can legitimately establish exact facts. A calibration task can improve knowledge without changing the material. Failed work can retain a useful product, evidence, parts or nothing under its actual contract, without mandatory random damage/fatigue. A body without conventional hands can use genuinely supported tools/assistance/faculty; category alone is not prohibition. No generic material simulator, new broad XP system or fields on every object are required by the palette.

F3: Workshop stock, throughput, station/tool custody, shared reservation, staffing, destinations and customer evidence differ. The12-parts/hour,4-parts/pump,3-pumps/hour example is internally consistent: expanding only parts does not raise that assembler's3-pump rate. This is a simple-chain hypothetical, not a solver for shared workers, multiple outputs, changing resource claims or stochastic yield. Better tolerances can change the useful application without increasing volume. Real alternative/superior means may remove bottlenecks. Factorio's anti-productive-loop salvage rationale stays its source design; AD22/AD38 do not require nerfing an intentionally valid creation/profit loop here.

F4: One recipient's adoption is distinct from awareness, prototype maturity, repeat production or regional diffusion. Actual actors, capacity, access, funds, carriers and clocks support each link; no automatic resistance or invented world reaction. MA11 natural development obeys the actual world-clock policy including AD16 inactive pause. Heirs inherit only real supported claims/people/records, and carried devices do not automatically recreate their factory. IR ordinary known crafting needs no compulsory hypothesis form; new goal/research, failed procedure, repeated evidence and independently transferred result retain separate status.

F5: J1 pump/water, J2 taught specialty/order and J3 preservation/delivery remain useful original proposals, not selected Frontier builds or source-qualified book mechanics. Their relative complexity is qualitative, not measured effort. The native formula/source inspection is a dated foundation, not proof all interfaces remain absent now. Current AD36/AD42/AD43/current compatibility govern selected checks, qualifying the report's mandatory human-review and blanket old-save wording. No native route, consumer, source acquisition, private save, build/browser, migration, worker, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: All181 lines read in two untruncated bounded outputs. Technology owner fully reviewed B556–B560; external pages/native source not reopened.
reviews.reopen: Only exact selected J/MI/WS/MA/IR consumer or changed source claim needs new qualification and native proof.

Preserve its distinct speculative J1–J3 consumer chains and selected-property approach. Historical reference docs/diaries and NIST/NASA analogies do not establish current game balance, compulsory readiness bars or certified measurements. The simple matched-capacity example is illustrative; valid creation/profit is not automatically nerfed to match another game's salvage design. Current clock, body/custody, AD36/AD42/AD43 and incumbent compatibility qualify the old natural-development/human/old-save shorthand. No linked-source re-fetch or gameplay proof was performed.
